rejected_rule.statement: The rule of jus accrescendi does not apply to deeds of gift, as evidenced by the specific wording and intent expressed in the deed.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "In the deed of 1875 proceeded upon an agreement between the parties and the deed was drawn up in terms of the agreement. It was not a joint gift to the several donees, as the donees were to take the property and own in equal shares. These words according to some eminent jurists negative any intention on the part of the testator to introduce the jus accrescendi."
